layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Mobile-first, dense but clear interactions (Swiss Utility).
layout_and_spacing.screen_wrapper: h-screen w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-gray-50 flex flex-col relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-white border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-around items-center h-16 pb-safe z-50
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard. Use p-4 or p-6 for screen edges. gap-4 for lists.

surfaces.bottom_sheet: bg-white rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] border-t border-gray-200 p-6 pt-2 absolute bottom-16 w-full z-40 transition-transform duration-300

map_search_tab.description: Interactive map filling the viewport above the nav. Floating filter chips at the top.
elements: Horizontal scrolling filter chips (Suburb, <$700k, >600m²). Use glassmorphism container for the chips wrapper.
Map marker pins: Circular, pure black (#0A0A0A) background with white price text.

property_details_sheet.description: Draggable bottom sheet that appears when a map pin is tapped.
elements: Drag handle: w-12 h-1.5 bg-gray-300 rounded-full mx-auto mb-4.
Key Stats Row: Beds, Baths, Land Size (e.g., 620m²). Use icon + text layout.

Frontage Calculator Widget: A distinct, slightly inset container (bg-gray-100 p-4 rounded-xl). Includes a number input for 'Street Width'. Dynamically shows 'Pass' (Green) if width >= 20m (10m per lot), else 'Fail' (Red).
Primary CTA: 'Save Property' (w-full bg-primary text-white h-12 rounded-lg font-semibold).
Header: 'Feasibility Calculator' with 'Estimate based on parameters' subtitle.
Inputs: Purchase Price, Stamp Duty, Civil Works ($80,000 pre-filled), Sale Price per Lot.
Forms: Use Shadcn Input components. Labels must be bold and clear. Use numeric keypads for mobile.
Live Gross Profit Card: Sticky or prominently placed. bg-primary text-white p-6 rounded-2xl. Large typography for profit value (hero_metric scale).
Thumbnail image on the left (w-24 h-24 rounded-lg object-cover), details on the right.
Unsave action: Small icon button (Trash or X) in the top right of the card.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='tab-map', data-testid='tab-saved', data-testid='tab-feasibility', data-testid='filter-chip-suburb', data-testid='property-pin-{id}', data-testid='frontage-input', data-testid='feasibility-purchase-price', data-testid='feasibility-civil-works', data-testid='gross-profit-value', data-testid='save-property-btn', data-testid='unsave-property-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using standard React JS (.js or .jsx), Tailwind CSS, and optionally Framer Motion.
Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). The file extensions must be JavaScript.

Since this is an Expo mobile app target but the environment uses standard React DOM, simulate the mobile experience strictly using standard DOM elements with 'max-w-md mx-auto h-screen relative overflow-hidden' to mimic a mobile viewport.

Use standard web-friendly libraries for the Map Tab (like react-leaflet or a simple interactive SVG map if Leaflet is uninstalled) since react-native-maps won't work in a standard React DOM setup. Set map zoom controls to false for a clean mobile look.
Implement the Bottom Sheet for property details anchored to the bottom (above the 16px nav bar).
The Feasibility Calculator logic: Gross Profit = (Sale Price per Lot * 2) - Purchase Price - Stamp Duty - Civil Works.
The Frontage Calculator logic: It requires 10m per lot. Since subdivision implies 2 lots, total street width entered must be >= 20m to show a 'Pass' indicator.
Fonts: Use standard Google Fonts links in HTML or standard Tailwind font-sans if specific imports are complex, but maintain the specified structural hierarchy.
